independentReview.scope: Default-on persistent/isolated settings, trusted messages and strict boolean, disabled native boundary, queued/active transport cancellation, final-await generation races, bound AV/internal positive retention beneath Chrome, permission activation/UI errors, unchanged protection limits; lifecycle fixture waits observable posted request without weakening deadline/reentrancy checks. Current source/dist/browser/native identities independently recomputed.

securityReview.npmAuditScope: npm dependency advisories only; bundled native/Wasm components and browser/OS vulnerabilities require separate review
securityReview.decoderMitigation: Dynamically bounded per-input whitelist excludes JPEG2000/PNM/MagicYUV/EXR/SANM families before FFprobe/FFmpeg decoding. Targeted exposure reduction, not an engine update.

buildProtection.limitation: Client decryption keys are embedded and recoverable; packaging is not a secrecy boundary. The manifest and license notices remain readable.

comparison.scope: Application JS excludes vendor engine/loader. Preference controls, cancellation/evidence guards and documentation increase bytes; no runtime speed or overall ZIP reduction claim.

antivirusEvidence: Native69 rerun for1.12.1. Python production sources unchanged from1.12.0; matching-module-hash realClamAV1.4.6 integration6 evidence retained, not newly rerun. Private test-only signatures; official database freshness/coverage and actual Windows APIs not validated.
limitations: Actual extension installation blocked by administrator policy; Chrome APIs doubled
Windows antivirus APIs not executed on Linux
User TXT sample is a short audio-only fragment; it cannot recreate a complete video
Client decryption keys are embedded and recoverable; JS/HTML/CSS, manifest, license notices and public source history remain readable
Encrypted packaging is for local developer-mode installation; Chrome Web Store policy acceptance is not validated
Older bundled FFmpeg5.1.4 and linked C libraries remain; identified decoder exposure is limited, not all CVEs patched
SANM blocked by name policy; no real SANM fixture executed
Native fallback signature probe and actual download are separate requests; large ID3 may be rejected
Static no-signals does not mean safe or replace Defender/other AV/Chrome protection; unknown malware and crafted media may be missed
Browser scan bounded to 256MiB, native to 2GiB minus 1; bounded structural analysis reports incomplete on scope limits; marker spanning distinct HLS chunks is not guaranteed detected
Browser cannot inspect arbitrary files written by Chrome downloads; updated native helper required for direct-disk full-file internal evidence; risk review can occur after the file is already saved
AV integration OFF disconnects app helper ports, not OS real-time protection or already-started OS scans; helper-dependent actual-disk internal scan unavailable while OFF
Incognito AV preference lives only in the current isolated worker execution memory; a new execution defaults ON

Actual extension optional-permission user gesture integration is unverified under administrator installation block; real Chromium UI tests verify active/expired activation behavior with Chrome API doubles

builtinRiskScreening.scope: Offline bounded static risk signals; never a complete malware verdict. Predecode checks, prepared/final-byte scan, native private snapshot scan, separate external AV status, SHA-256/size-bound evidence and sticky risk review. No file execution/unpacking/upload. Direct disk scans require updated helper.
builtinRiskScreening.releaseGuard: Build and packaging reject a contiguous standard harmless antivirus test marker in distributable sources/resources/reports; tests construct it only at runtime. Test media/signatures/databases excluded from ZIPs.
builtinRiskScreening.benchmarkScope: Five existing algorithm domains rerun against current source. UI baseline receives presentation-only in-memory adaptation with original/adapted hashes, full text equality and focus/token/pending checks retained. Not a whole-scanner throughput benchmark.

antivirusIntegration.normalPersistence: Validated boolean in existing IndexedDB settings store; schema1 unchanged
antivirusIntegration.incognitoPersistence: Isolated execution memory only; never reads or writes normal-window AV setting
antivirusIntegration.disabledStatus: local-only disabled; native parsers reject forged disabled
antivirusIntegration.disabledBehavior: No new native readiness/scan requests; queued and pre-permission requests recheck policy; active ports disconnected and late replies ignored. Benign new downloads complete distinctly unscanned; no automatic processing. Browser byte/predecode checks, OS AV and Chrome protection remain. Helper-dependent actual disk internal scans do not run.
antivirusIntegration.riskRetention: Known AV threats, native-only hash/size-bound internal suspicious findings and prepared-byte risk survive Chrome priority, OFF and browser acceptance; explicit rescan while OFF cannot clear prior evidence.
antivirusIntegration.raceProtection: Connection and preference generations reject stale active/queued callbacks and stale final preference GET across OFF or OFF-to-ON; finalizing offer generations revoked on committed OFF.
antivirusIntegration.permissionControl: Fresh authoritative setting checked before optional permission prompt, with active user activation; expired click requests an explicit new click. Unknown/read/save failure disables uncertain controls and offers reread.
